title: Alchemist's Fire
summary: Throw one flask as an Action to create a 10 ft-radius Fire surface for 3 turns.

fields.Activation: Action. Throw and consume one flask. Range 60 ft.
fields.Surface: 10 ft radius for 3 turns. The Fire surface deals 1d4 Fire per turn and applies Burning.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Burning duration: The item’s three-turn Burning is normally overwritten by the surface’s one-turn Burning. If a Fire surface cannot form, the item’s full Burning duration can apply.
fields.Crafting: Combine Ashes of Fire Amber with any Salt.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
